主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: NICK) reported a 40% decline in net earnings to $2,860,000 for the three months ended March 31, 2014, compared to $4,787,000 for the same period in 2013. Diluted earnings per share also dropped 41% to $0.23, down from $0.39 in the prior year period. Revenue increased by less than 1% to $20,443,000 for the quarter ended March 31, 2014, compared to $20,372,000 for the same period in 2013.
